question: What follows when Shri Para Devi is established as all-pervading?
premises: Bhairava is placed with supreme power
inference: The verse links divine establishment to ritual placement.
uncertainties: exact sense of vāmāre is uncertain
plain_english: May it be supreme, together with the supreme power, on the left side, and Bhairava; thus, when Shri Para Devi is established in the all-pervading state.
